summary: Iteration 52 — Backend tests for batch A+B+C (applied 2026-05-12). All 10 tests PASSED. Covered: (A) tickets tab filter atendendo/aguardando matches /counts badge — FIX verified; (B) Connection.queue_ids persists on POST + clears on PUT with empty list; (C) Company-user allowed_queue_ids persists on POST + updates on PUT; (D) GET /api/crm/flows/{id}/export returns portable JSON (strips id/company_id), 404 for missing; (E) webhook /api/channels/webhook/message auto-assigns queue_id when connection has exactly 1 queue; (F) /api/quotes/templates POST with PDF base64 + mimetype application/pdf is converted server-side to image/png (verified PNG magic bytes); (G) GET /api/quotes/{qid}/pdf falls back to default-template letterhead when the quote's template has no layout (size_with > size_without by >1kB); (H) Kanban columns accept order=5 on POST and order=2 on PUT.
critical_code_review_comments: crm_routes._ticket_visibility_filter (line 44) correctly returns empty dict for admin/super_admin/view_all — Boss admin sees all tickets, so list lengths exactly match counts. Good.
channels_routes.update_connection (line 1050) uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) and explicitly handles queue_ids=[] — empty list is preserved as cleared binding. ✓

channels_routes.webhook_message (line 837): `(conn.get('queue_ids') or [None])[0] if len(...) == 1 else None` — assigns queue_id only when EXACTLY 1 queue. For 0 or 2+ queues, ticket.queue_id stays None. Correct per spec.

quotes_routes._maybe_convert_pdf_layout_to_png (line 34) catches generic Exception and returns original payload on failure — defensive but masks real bugs in logs. Consider raising in dev, logging stack trace in prod (currently uses logger.warning).

quotes_routes._build_quote_html fallback (line 1183-1193): default template inheritance covers layout image + paddings, NOT header/footer/content. Behaviour matches spec ('fallback ao layout do default template').
